text: models fit using MCMC stanfit object also contain values parameters used sampler. get_sampler_params function can used access information. object returned get_sampler_params list one component (matrix) per chain. matrices number columns corresponding number sampler parameters column names provide parameter names. optional argument inc_warmup (defaulting TRUE) indicates whether include warmup period. things like calculate average value accept_stat__ chain (maximum value treedepth__ chain using NUTS algorithm, etc.) sapply function useful apply function component sampler_params:

title: Convergence and efficiency diagnostics for Markov Chains — Rhat
text: Rhat function produces R-hat convergence diagnostic, compares - within-chain estimates model parameters univariate quantities interest. chains mixed well (ie, - within-chain estimates agree), R-hat larger 1. recommend running least four chains default using sample R-hat less 1.05. Stan reports R-hat maximum rank normalized split-R-hat rank normalized folded-split-R-hat, works thick tailed distributions sensitive also differences scale. ess_bulk function produces estimated Bulk Effective Sample Size (bulk-ESS) using rank normalized draws. Bulk-ESS useful measure sampling efficiency bulk distribution (related e.g. efficiency mean median estimates), well defined even chains finite mean variance. ess_tail function produces estimated Tail Effective Sample Size (tail-ESS) computing minimum effective sample sizes 5% 95% quantiles. Tail-ESS useful measure sampling efficiency tails distribution (related e.g. efficiency variance tail quantile estimates). bulk-ESS tail-ESS least \(100\) (approximately) per Markov Chain order reliable indicate estimates respective posterior quantiles reliable.

code: scode <- " data {   int<lower = 1> N;   real<lower = 0> a;   real<lower = 0> b; } transformed data { // these adhere to the conventions above   real pi_ = beta_rng(a, b);   int y = binomial_rng(N, pi_); } parameters {   real<lower = 0, upper = 1> pi; } model {   target += beta_lpdf(pi | a, b);   target += binomial_lpmf(y | N, pi); } generated quantities { // these adhere to the conventions above   int y_ = y;   vector[1] pars_;   int ranks_[1] = {pi > pi_};   vector[N] log_lik;   pars_[1] = pi_;   for (n in 1:y) log_lik[n] = bernoulli_lpmf(1 | pi);   for (n in (y + 1):N) log_lik[n] = bernoulli_lpmf(0 | pi); } "

title: Demonstrate examples included in Stan — stan_demo

title: Class stanfit: fitted Stan model — stanfit-class
text: object class stanfit contains output derived fitting Stan model returned top-level function stan lower-level methods sampling vb (defined class stanmodel). Many methods (e.g., print, plot, summary) provided summarizing results various access methods also allow underlying data (e.g., simulations, diagnostics) contained object retrieved.

title: Class stanfit: fitted Stan model — stanfit-class
text: model_name: model name string. model_pars: character vector names parameters       (including transformed parameters derived quantities). par_dims: named list giving dimensions       parameters. dimension scalar parameter given       numeric(0). mode: integer indicating mode fitted model.        0 indicates sampling mode, 1 indicates test gradient mode        (sampling done), 2 indicates error mode (error occurred        sampling). methods stanfit objects useful        mode=0. sim: list containing simulation results including       posterior draws well various pieces metadata used many       methods stanfit objects. inits: initial values (either user-specified generated       randomly) chains. list one component per chain.       component named list containing initial values parameter       corresponding chain. stan_args: list one component per chain containing       arguments used sampling (e.g. iter, seed, etc.). stanmodel: instance S4 class stanmodel. date: string containing date time object created. .MISC: Miscellaneous helper information used fitted model.       object type environment. Users rarely (ever)       need access contents .MISC.

title: Class stanfit: fitted Stan model — stanfit-class
text: Printing, plotting, summarizing: show Print default summary model. print Print customizable summary model.       See print.stanfit. plot Create various plots summarizing fitted model.       See plot,stanfit-method. summary Summarize distributions estimated       parameters derived quantities using posterior draws.       See summary,stanfit-method. get_posterior_mean Get posterior mean parameters interest (using pars       specify subset parameters). Returned matrix       one column per chain additional column chains combined. Extracting posterior draws: extract Extract draws chains       (specified) parameters. See extract. .array, .matrix, .data.frame Coerce draws (without warmup) array,       matrix data frame. See .array.stanfit. .mcmc.list Convert stanfit object       mcmc.list package coda.       See .mcmc.list. get_logposterior Get log-posterior iteration.       element returned list vector log-posterior       values (additive constant, .e. multiplicative constant       linear scale) single chain.       optional argument inc_warmup (defaulting TRUE)       indicates whether include warmup period. Diagnostics, log probability, gradients: get_sampler_params Obtain parameters used sampler       stepsize treedepth. results returned       list one component (array) per chain.       array number columns corresponding number       parameters used sampler column names       provide parameter names. Optional argument inc_warmup       (defaulting TRUE) indicates whether include warmup period. get_adaptation_info Obtain adaptation information sampler NUTS used.       results returned list, element character       string info single chain. log_prob Compute log probability density (lp__) set parameter       values (unconstrained space) additive constant.       unconstrained parameters specified using numeric vector.       number parameters unconstrained space can obtained       using method get_num_upars. numeric value returned. See also       documentation log_prob. grad_log_prob Compute gradient log probability density function set parameter       values (unconstrained space) additive constant.       unconstrained parameters specified using numeric vector       length number unconstrained parameters.       numeric vector returned length number       unconstrained parameters attribute named log_prob       lp__. See also documentation grad_log_prob. get_num_upars Get number unconstrained parameters model. number parameters       model necessarily equal number unconstrained       parameters. example, parameter specified simplex       length K, number unconstrained parameters K-1. unconstrain_pars Transform parameters unconstrained space. input named list       specifying initial values parameter. numeric vector       returned. See also documentation unconstrain_pars. constrain_pars Get parameter values unconstrained space. input       numeric vector. list returned.  function contrary       unconstrain_pars. See also documentation       constrain_pars. Metadata miscellaneous: get_stancode Get Stan code fitted model string. result can       printed readable format using cat. get_stanmodel Get object S4 class stanmodel fitted       model. get_elapsed_time Get warmup time sample time seconds.       matrix two columns returned row containing warmup       sample times one chain. get_inits, iter = NULL Get initial values parameters used sampling chains.       returned object list structure inits       slot described . object@mode=2 (error mode) empty list       returned. iter NULL, draw       iteration returned chain rather initial state. get_cppo_mode Get optimization mode used compilation. returned string       one "fast", "presentation2", "presentation1",       "debug". get_seed Get (P)RNG seed used. fitted object       empty (mode=2), NULL might returned.       case seeds chains different, use       get_seeds. get_seeds Get seeds used chains. fitted object       empty (mode=2), NULL might returned.

text: object object class stanfit. pars optional character vector providing parameter     names (quantity names) interest. specified,     parameters quantities used. log-posterior     name lp__ also included default. permuted logical scalar indicating whether draws     warmup period chain permuted     merged. title: Extract samples from a fitted Stan model — extract
text: permuted = TRUE, function returns named list,   every element array representing samples parameter   chains merged together. permuted = FALSE, array returned; first   dimension iterations, second number chains,   third parameters. text: object object class stanmodel. data named list environment     providing data model character vector     names objects used data.     See Passing data Stan section stan. pars NA, character vector naming parameters,     included output include = TRUE excluded     include = FALSE. default, parameters included. include Logical scalar defaulting TRUE indicating     whether include exclude parameters given     pars argument. FALSE, entire multidimensional     parameters can excluded, rather particular elements . seed seed random number generation. default generated     1 maximum integer supported R machine. Even     multiple chains used, one seed needed, chains     seeds derived first chain avoid dependent samples.     seed specified number, .integer applied .     .integer produces NA, seed generated randomly.     seed can also specified character string digits,     "12345", converted integer. init Initial values specification. See detailed documentation     init argument stan. check_data Logical, defaulting TRUE. TRUE     data preprocessed; otherwise .     See Passing data Stan section stan. sample_file character string file name specifying     write samples parameters saved quantities.     defaults temporary file. algorithm Either "meanfield" (default) "fullrank",     indicating variational inference algorithm used. "meanfield"     option uses fully factorized Gaussian approximation whereas     fullrank option uses Gaussian full-rank covariance matrix     approximation. Details additional references available     Stan manual. importance_resampling Logical scalar (defaulting FALSE) indicating     whether importance resampling adjust draws optimum     like draws posterior distribution keep_every Integer scalar (defaulting 1) indicating interval     thin draws imporance_resampling = TRUE ... optional parameters: iter (positive integer), maximum number       iterations, defaulting 10000. grad_samples (positive integer), number samples       Monte Carlo estimate gradients, defaulting 1. elbo_samples (positive integer), number samples       Monte Carlo estimate ELBO (objective function), defaulting 100.       (ELBO stands "evidence lower bound".) eta (double), positive stepsize weighting parameter       variational inference ignored adaptation engaged,       case default. adapt_engaged (logical), flag indicating whether       automatically adapt stepsize, defaulting TRUE. tol_rel_obj (positive double), convergence tolerance       relative norm objective, defaulting 0.01. eval_elbo (positive integer), evaluate ELBO every Nth       iteration, defaulting 100. output_samples (positive integer), number posterior       samples draw save, defaults 1000. adapt_iter (positive integer), maximum number       iterations adapt stepsize, defaulting 50. Ignored       adapt_engaged = FALSE. Refer manuals CmdStan Stan details.
